lines.en: label mall45:
scene mall1
I make my way to the mall because I’m in a generous mood and want to buy presents for Ayane and Maya since they’ve been through a lot lately.
lines.zh: 我心情大方，去了趟商场，想给 Ayane 和 Maya 买礼物，毕竟她们最近经历了不少。

lines.en: Oh, who am I kidding? I’m here to hang out with Chika.
lines.zh: 哦，我骗谁呢？我是来找 Chika 的。

lines.en: The “Sensei Love Squad” is nice and all, don’t get me wrong. Like, it’s an entire squad centered around loving me and things don’t really get any better than that.
lines.zh: 「Sensei 后援团」是很不错，别误会。我的意思是，一整个团队的存在意义就是爱我，没有比这更好的了。

lines.en: But it’s also nice taking time off every now and then to remind myself that there are girls still mostly detached from the crazy happenings of the universe.
lines.zh: 但偶尔抽身出来，提醒自己还有那么几个女孩基本上没被宇宙里的疯狂事件卷进去，也挺好的。

lines.en: scene black
As I round the corner and head into Le French Store or whatever Chika’s business is called, that thought rings out in my head.
lines.zh: 当我拐过弯、走进那家「法国店」——或者不管 Chika 的店叫什么名字——这个念头在我脑海里回响。

lines.en: It bounces back and forth in the leftmost section of my brain until dissolving into nothingness and leaving me with the cranial aftertaste of complacency and nonchalance.
lines.zh: 它在我大脑最左侧的区域来回弹跳，直到消散成虚无，只给我留下一丝自满与漫不经心的颅内余味。

lines.en: scene chikascarves1
But then it sours as I see Chika holding a familiar scarf — and those dissolved thoughts reform once more.
lines.zh: 但接着它变味了——因为我看见 Chika 手里拿着一条眼熟的围巾，那些消散的念头又重新聚拢。

lines.en: No one is detached from the crazy happenings of the universe.
lines.zh: 没有人能脱离宇宙里的疯狂事件。

lines.en: But it would be nice if I was able to believe they were for more than just a few minutes at a time.
lines.zh: 不过，要是能让我相信有人能脱离，哪怕一次只有几分钟，也挺好的。

lines.en: : Can I help you?
lines.zh: : 需要帮忙吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. I’m looking for a girl around your age who might want to make out for a little while.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我在找一个跟你年纪相仿、可能愿意跟我亲热一会儿的女孩。

lines.en: : Sorry. I have a boyfriend.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我有男朋友了。

lines.en: : I know. I am him.
lines.zh: : 我知道。我就是他。

lines.en: scene chikascarves2
: Huh? You’re-
lines.zh: : 哈？你是-

lines.en: scene chikascarves3
: Ah! Hey! I wasn’t expecting you today.
lines.zh: : 啊！嘿！没想到你今天会来。

lines.en: : I could tell by the way you so quickly rejected me.
lines.zh: : 从你刚才那么干脆地拒绝我，我看得出来。

lines.en: scene chikascarves4
: Yeah, sorry about that. There was another guy a couple hours ago who tried the same thing, so I like, half-expected you to just be him coming back.
lines.zh: : 是啊，抱歉啦。几小时前也有个男的对我来这套，所以我有一半以为你是他回来了。

lines.en: : There was another guy who just...approached you and asked you to make out?
lines.zh: : 有个男的就……走上前来问你要不要亲热？

lines.en: scene chikascarves5
: He actually only asked where the bathroom is. But I still told him I had a boyfriend and that made him go away.
lines.zh: : 他其实只问了洗手间在哪儿。但我还是告诉他我有男朋友，然后他就走了。

lines.en: : I wonder if he ever found the bathroom?
lines.zh: : 不知道他最后找到洗手间没有？

lines.en: Well, at least I know she’s loyal.
lines.zh: 好吧，至少我知道她很忠诚。

lines.en: : Kinda weird, though. We’ve had several guys come into the mall today. Thought for a second the war might have ended. Turns out there’s just some porn convention going on this weekend.
lines.zh: : 不过挺怪的。今天商场里来了好几个男的。我一度以为是战争结束了。结果只是这个周末有个成人展。

lines.en: : And we’re not there...why?
lines.zh: : 那我们为什么不去……

lines.en: scene chikascarves6
: Because I can’t legally get in.
lines.zh: : 因为我法定年龄进不去。

lines.en: : Oh. Yeah, that’ll do it.
lines.zh: : 哦。对，这倒是。

lines.en: : Are you that into porn, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你那么爱看色情片吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : That depends.
lines.zh: : 看情况。

lines.en: : On?
lines.zh: : 看什么情况？

lines.en: : If this is some sort of trap.
lines.zh: : 看这是不是某种陷阱。

lines.en: scene chikascarves7
: It’s not a {i}trap.{/i} I’m not one of those girls who forbids her boyfriend from watching porn. I get that I can’t be there to assist you {i}all{/i} the time.
lines.zh: : 不是{i}陷阱{/i}。我不是那种禁止男朋友看片的女孩。我知道我没法{i}时时刻刻{/i}都在旁边伺候你。

lines.en: scene chikascarves8
: So, in my moments of absence, feel free to jerk off to whatever or whoever you like without the fear of me getting jealous.
lines.zh: : 所以，在我不在的时候，你想对着什么、对着谁打飞机都行，不用担心我吃醋。

lines.en: : But also know that if any of that ever leaks into reality and you wind up cheating on me...I will destroy everything you love. Not including myself, of course.
lines.zh: : 但你也得知道，如果那些东西有任何一点渗进现实、你最后出轨了……我会毁掉你所爱的一切。当然，不包括我自己。

lines.en: : I feel like that part didn’t need to be included, but thank you nonetheless. I will also allow you to look at porn if that makes me sound like a good and respectful significant other.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那部分其实不必加，不过还是谢谢你。我也允许你看片——如果这么说能让我听起来像个体贴的好男友的话。

lines.en: scene chikascarves9
: I’ll keep that in mind. Not like I have much time for that stuff anyway, though. Between work, Chinami, Yumi, and you...my time is pretty much all taken up.
lines.zh: : 我会记住的。不过反正我也没多少时间弄那些。工作、Chinami、Yumi，还有你……我的时间基本都被占满了。

lines.en: : I would have liked going to that convention with you, though. Sounds fun.
lines.zh: : 不过我倒是挺想跟你一起去那个展的。听起来挺好玩。

lines.en: : On that note, how’s Chinami doing?
lines.zh: : 说到这个，Chinami 怎么样了？

lines.en: scene chikascarves2
: Chinami? Fine. Why do you ask?
lines.zh: : Chinami？挺好的。为什么问这个？

lines.en: : Between the fever and her immune-thing-
lines.zh: : 发烧的事，还有她那个免疫方面的-

lines.en: : Fever? Chinami hasn’t had a fever in months. Where did you hear that?
lines.zh: : 发烧？Chinami 好几个月都没发烧了。你从哪儿听来的？

lines.en: : So...she’s totally fine?
lines.zh: : 所以……她完全没事？

lines.en: : Probably even {i}better{/i} than fine. Her and Tsukasa have been going crazy lately. Something about making the Fortune 500 or something?
lines.zh: : 大概比{i}没事{/i}还要{i}好{/i}。她和 Tsukasa 最近疯得很。好像在搞什么财富 500 强之类的？

lines.en: Did the reset...somehow cure Chinami?
lines.zh: 重置……把 Chinami 治好了吗？

lines.en: I know Maya alluded to physical stuff being reset sometimes as well, but I guess it didn’t occur to me that it could work like this.
lines.zh: 我知道 Maya 提过，有时候身体上的东西也会跟着重置，但我没想到它能这么起作用。

lines.en: That’s...kind of great, actually. There’s finally another benefit to this whole infinite time thing other than just giving me the ability to bone teenage girls for the rest of my life.
lines.zh: 这……其实挺棒的。这个无限时间的东西终于有了另一个好处，而不只是让我这辈子都能睡未成年女孩。

lines.en: : Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei？

lines.en: : Oh, my bad. Must have been misremembering or something. I’m glad to hear she’s doing okay, though.
lines.zh: : 哦，我的错。大概是记混了什么的。不过很高兴听到她没事。

lines.en: scene chikascarves8
: Heh...it’s cute you were worried about her. But yeah, she's fine.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……你还会担心她，真可爱。不过是啊，她很好。

lines.en: : Great. So, back to the porn thing.
lines.zh: : 很好。那么，回到色情片的话题。

lines.en: scene chikascarves10
: Are you really that desperate to not come across as sentimental? It’s fine if you sound a little caring every now and then, you know. I like that side of you.
lines.zh: : 你真的这么拼命不想显得多愁善感吗？偶尔听起来有点关心人也没关系的，你知道吧。我喜欢你那一面。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t be dating you if {i}all{/i} I was into was the sex.
lines.zh: : 如果{i}我{/i}只图性，我就不会跟你交往了。

lines.en: : To be fair, the sex is pretty great. I wouldn’t blame you.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，那方面确实很棒。我不会怪你。

lines.en: scene chikascarves11
: It {i}is{/i} pretty great, isn’t it? Maybe {i}we{/i} should do porn? Couples videos are getting pretty big nowadays, aren’t they?
lines.zh: : {i}确实{/i}很棒，不是吗？也许{i}我们{/i}该去拍片？情侣视频现在挺火的吧？

lines.en: : How do you know that if you never have time to watch anything?
lines.zh: : 你不是说没时间看吗，怎么会知道？

lines.en: : I didn’t say {i}never.{/i} I just said it was hard to find the time for that stuff. Which is true.
lines.zh: : 我没说{i}从来不看{/i}。我只是说很难挤出时间。这是实话。

lines.en: : Either way, we probably shouldn’t have any physical, recorded evidence of our sexual relationship.
lines.zh: : 总之，我们大概不该留下任何有形的、录下来的性关系证据。

lines.en: : Not even for when we’re older and you want to relive the glory days of fucking my tight, teen pussy?
lines.zh: : 就算是为了等我们老了、你想回味当年操我那个紧致的少女小穴的光辉岁月，也不行？

lines.en: : Welp, congratulations. Now I’m turned on.
lines.zh: : 好吧，恭喜你。我现在硬了。

lines.en: scene chikascarves12
: Just doing my job. I’m only half-serious about the porn thing, though.
lines.zh: : 尽职而已。不过拍片这事我只有一半是认真的。

lines.en: : Like, yeah, it would be nice to look back on that kind of stuff one day. But at the same time, the idea of anyone else being able to see us online is pretty nerve-wracking.
lines.zh: : 就是说，是啊，有一天能回头看那种东西是挺好。但同时，一想到别人能在网上看到我们，我就挺发毛的。

lines.en: : So if we ever {i}did{/i} make any sort of videos, I’d probably want to keep them private.
lines.zh: : 所以如果我们{i}真的{/i}拍了什么视频，我大概会想把它们私藏起来。

lines.en: scene chikascarves13
: It does hurt kissing all of that potential money goodbye, though. Between your huge dick and my body, we could probably rake it in.
lines.zh: : 不过跟那些潜在的钱说再见，确实挺肉疼的。凭你那根大鸡巴和我的身材，我们大概能赚翻。

lines.en: : I know you’re desperate for cash on account of the whole poverty thing, but I didn’t think you’d gotten to “considering porn” territory just yet.
lines.zh: : 我知道你因为穷很缺钱，但我没想到你已经到「考虑拍片」的地步了。

lines.en: scene chikascarves14
: It’s not a real consideration — just a little thought that came to me today on account of the convention buzz.
lines.zh: : 不是真的在考虑-只是今天被展会的氛围带动，冒出来的一个小念头。

lines.en: scene chikascarves15
: I do have to do {i}something,{/i} though. It dawned on me during Christmas that what I make now is fine for just getting by, but it doesn’t really let me {i}save{/i} anything.
lines.zh: : 不过我{i}确实{/i}得做点什么。圣诞节的时候我突然意识到，我现在挣的钱只够勉强过日子，根本让我{i}存{/i}不下什么。

lines.en: : I don’t want to have to rely on you to take care of me forever. I want to be able to, like...put money away for a house or something. Or at least a nicer apartment.
lines.zh: : 我不想一辈子都得靠你养。我想能……存钱买个房子什么的。或者至少换个好点的公寓。

lines.en: : Folding scarves is easy, laid-back work...but it’s not going to get me to that point.
lines.zh: : 叠围巾是轻松、不费神的工作……但它带不到那个位置。

lines.en: : That said...that scarf looks a little familiar, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 话说回来……那条围巾看着有点眼熟，对吧？

lines.en: scene chikascarves16
: I’m trying to have a melancholic talk about my future and you’re more focused on the {i}scarf{/i} part? What the heck?
lines.zh: : 我正想来一段关于我未来的感伤谈话，你却更关注{i}围巾{/i}那部分？什么鬼？

lines.en: : Am I right, though?
lines.zh: : 不过我说得对吧？

lines.en: scene chikascarves17
: Hmm...now that you mention it, it does look kind of like Maya’s. And the other one looks a lot like Ami’s.
lines.zh: : 嗯……你这么一说，确实有点像 Maya 的。另一条很像 Ami 的。

lines.en: : They have to be different, though. I mean, they’re {i}obviously{/i} different since they already own theirs. But these ones here were like, {i}just{/i} made for this brand’s new winter line.
lines.zh: : 不过肯定不一样。我是说，它们{i}显然{/i}不同，因为她俩已经有了。可这几条是……这个品牌冬季新品{i}刚{/i}做出来的。

lines.en: : In fact, I’m not even supposed to be putting them out yet. But we needed display pieces over here and I figured it would be fine so long as they’re not priced.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我本来还不该把它们摆出来。只是这边需要展示品，我想只要不标价就没关系。

lines.en: They’re the same scarves.
lines.zh: 它们是同一批围巾。

lines.en: Chika might have an eye for fashion, but I’ve seen them both up close far too often to mistake them at this point.
lines.zh: Chika 也许对时尚很有眼光，但我近距离见过那两条太多次了，到这会儿绝不可能认错。

lines.en: But, if they’re from a brand new clothing line...how would that even work, exactly?
lines.zh: 可是，如果它们来自一个全新的服装系列……那到底是怎么一回事？

lines.en: Were the ones I bought here previously just...prototypes or something?
lines.zh: 我之前在这儿买的那两条，难道只是……原型什么的？

lines.en: scene black
I do my best to think back on how that conversation went...
lines.zh: 我尽力回想那次对话是怎么进行的……

lines.en: scene chikascarves18
: Looking for a gift now, Sir?
lines.zh: : 先生，现在在找礼物吗？

lines.en: : These actually just came in this morning.
lines.zh: : 这些其实是今天早上刚到的。

lines.en: scene chikascarves19
: It was so strange as well. We never ordered anything like these.
lines.zh: : 而且特别奇怪。我们根本没订过这种东西。

lines.en: : But it’s not like I was about to just let them go to waste so...voila.
lines.zh: : 但我也总不能就让它们白白浪费掉，所以……瞧。

lines.en: : So you’re selling things you never even ordered? How do you know how they should be priced?
lines.zh: : 所以你们在卖根本没订过的货？那你怎么知道该定什么价？

lines.en: scene chikascarves20
: Oh, I have no idea. I just guessed.
lines.zh: : 哦，我完全不知道。我就随便猜的。

lines.en: : If you act now, I’ll let you have both for just 4,000 Yen. My regional manager is on the way here anyway so I was actually just about to take them down and hide them.
lines.zh: : 你要是现在下手，两条我算你 4000 日元。我的区域经理正好在来的路上，我其实正准备把它们撤下来藏起来。

lines.en: : So I’m basically the only chance you have of selling these?
lines.zh: : 所以基本上，我是你唯一能把它们卖出去的机会？

lines.en: : You are! And-
lines.zh: : 没错！而且-

: ...That’s half of the asking price.
lines.zh: : ……那是要价的一半。

lines.en: : There is no asking price. This isn't even an item you're supposed to carry.
lines.zh: : 根本就没有什么要价。这甚至都不是你们该卖的东西。

lines.en: : 2,000 Yen or I walk.
lines.zh: : 2000 日元，不然我走。

lines.en: : Fine...
lines.zh: : 好吧……

lines.en: : I guess this is my fault for revealing my secrets to you in the first place...
lines.zh: : 我猜这也是我自作自受，谁让我先把秘密告诉你了……

lines.en: : Helloooo? Sensei? Anyone home?
lines.zh: : 喂————？Sensei？有人在吗？

lines.en: scene chikascarves2
: Was there ever another girl who worked here?
lines.zh: : 这儿以前是不是还有另一个女孩在这儿工作？

lines.en: : Uhh...yeah. Tons. This is a high end fashion store in the mall.
lines.zh: : 呃……有啊。很多。这可是商场里的高端时装店。

lines.en: : Why, though? Is there another girl who hit on you that I need to jump? I mean...talk to?
lines.zh: : 不过为什么问这个？是不是又有个女孩跟你搭讪，需要我去揍她？我是说……谈谈？

lines.en: : I’m just pretty sure I bought these exact scarves from someone else here...
lines.zh: : 我只是很确定，我之前是从这儿的别人手里买到这几条围巾的……

lines.en: : Uhh, well...first off, never buy anything here from anyone but me.
lines.zh: : 呃，好吧……首先，除了我之外，别在这儿跟任何人买东西。

lines.en: : But second, that’s not possible. Like I said, these are brand new. So unless you got your hands on, like, rough cuts of them or something, there’s no way.
lines.zh: : 其次，那不可能。就像我说的，这些都是全新的。所以除非你拿到的是，比如说，粗样之类的，否则不可能。

lines.en: : Would something like that even be sold here?
lines.zh: : 那种东西会在这儿卖吗？

lines.en: : I doubt it. That stuff is normally saved for, like...models or the family of the designers and whatnot.
lines.zh: : 我怀疑不会。那种东西一般是留给……模特或者设计师的家人之类的。

lines.zh: : 你干嘛这么执着于这几条围巾？现在又不是冬天。

lines.en: scene chikascarves27
: Oh, nothing! Hahahah! Sensei was just telling me the funniest joke! Weren’t you, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 哦，没什么！哈哈哈哈！Sensei 刚给我讲了个超好笑的笑话！对吧，Sensei？

lines.en: scene chikascarves28
: Uhh...yes.
: Knock knock.
lines.zh: : 咚咚咚。

lines.en: : Who’s there?
lines.zh: : 谁啊？

lines.en: : Doctor.
lines.zh: : Doctor。

lines.en: : Doctor who?
lines.zh: : Doctor who？

lines.en: scene chikascarves29
: Oh, I get it! Like that one British TV show with the phone-
lines.zh: : 哦，我懂了！就像那部英国电视剧，里面有个电话-

lines.en: : Doctor Patterson. I regret to inform you that the cancer has spread to your grandfather’s brain and...he isn’t going to make it.
lines.zh: : Patterson 医生。我很遗憾地通知您，癌细胞已经扩散到您祖父的大脑，而且……他撑不过去了。

lines.en: : I'm sorry you have to find out like this. I know it's sudden.
lines.zh: : 很抱歉你是以这种方式得知的。我知道这很突然。

lines.en: scene chikascarves30
: Hahah...hah...funny, right?
lines.zh: : 哈哈……哈……好笑吧？

lines.en: : Normally, my traumas don’t catch up to me until nighttime. Good joke, Sensei. I’ve never had comedy change my entire schedule around before.
lines.zh: : 通常我的心理创伤要到晚上才会追上我。讲得好，Sensei。我还从没因为一段喜剧把自己的整个日程都改了。

lines.en: : Sooooo...ignoring everything that’s happened over the last twenty seconds, what are you guys doing here?
lines.zh: : 那……无视掉过去二十秒发生的一切，你俩在这儿干嘛呢？

lines.en: : I don’t know anymore. I just don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道了。我就是不知道。

lines.en: : You don’t have to pretend to be interested in us. It’s not like you’re obligated to greet every single familiar face you encounter out in the open. You’re just going to make people uncomfortable doing that.
lines.zh: : 你不必假装对我们感兴趣。你又没义务在公开场合跟每一个熟面孔打招呼。你那样做只会让别人不自在。

lines.en: scene chikascarves31
: What was that, Io?
lines.zh: : 你刚才说什么，Io？

lines.en: Well, it seems that Io’s distaste for Chika is one thing the reset can {i}not{/i} cure.
lines.zh: 看来，Io 对 Chika 的厌恶，是重置也{i}治{/i}不好的东西。

lines.en: : I said-
lines.zh: : 我说-

lines.en: : Hahah! She’s got jokes of her own too! You’d just never know with how quiet she is in school! Hahaha! Anyway, hi! Don’t kill us, please.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈！她自己也有笑话呢！你在学校里看她那么安静，根本想不到！哈哈哈！总之，嗨！别杀我们，拜托。

lines.en: scene chikascarves32
: I wouldn’t kill you, Uta. I like- are you blushing right now?
lines.zh: : 我不会杀你的，Uta。我喜欢-你现在是在脸红吗？

lines.en: : You’re really pretty and being touched by you sent special signals to my brain. I'm sorry.
lines.zh: : 你真的很漂亮，被你摸到让我的大脑收到了特别的信号。抱歉。

lines.en: scene chikascarves33
: God, you are so friggin’ adorable!
lines.zh: : 天哪，你真是太可爱了！

lines.en: : {i}Hah...Heaven...{/i}
: Who’s a good girl? {i}Who’s a good girl?{/i}
lines.zh: : 谁是乖女孩？{i}谁是乖女孩？{/i}

lines.en: : Uta-chan...is a good girl...
lines.zh: : Uta-chan……是乖女孩……

lines.en: : I’m going to puke.
lines.zh: : 我要吐了。

lines.en: : If only your best friend wasn’t so unbearable! Maybe then you and me could hang out more?
lines.zh: : 要是你那个好朋友没那么让人受不了就好了！那样也许你和我就能多出去玩了？

lines.en: scene chikascarves34
: Oh, please. As if Uta would ever stoop to-
lines.zh: : 哦，拜托。好像 Uta 会-

lines.en: : Shh...
: Let me have this...
lines.zh: : 让我享受这一刻……

lines.en: : Pardon the interruption, but my partially-twisted mind has immediately come up with a way to make that happen {i}and{/i} potentially solve your financial issues, Chika.
lines.zh: : 抱歉打断一下，但我那颗有点扭曲的脑子立刻想到了一个办法，既能让那件事发生，{i}又{/i}有可能解决你的财务问题，Chika。

lines.en: scene chikascarves36
: It has?! How?! What is it?! What do I have to do?!
lines.zh: : 真的？！怎么做？！是什么？！我要做什么？！

lines.en: : Sell your soul.
lines.zh: : 卖掉你的灵魂。

lines.en: : I thought I already told you porn was a no-go.
lines.zh: : 我以为我说过色情片不行。

lines.en: : Which is why you settle for the next best thing — a maid cafe.
lines.zh: : 所以你退而求其次——女仆咖啡厅。

lines.en: scene chikascarves37
: Mm!
: Thank you, Sensei! I’ve remembered my place in the world and am now back to normal!
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Sensei！我想起自己在世界上的位置了，现在恢复正常了！

lines.en: : Me? Working at a maid cafe? Alongside Uta and Ami? Yeah, no way. They’ve got a totally different appeal than me. There’s no way that would work.
lines.zh: : 我？去女仆咖啡厅上班？跟 Uta 和 Ami 一起？算了吧，不行。她们的魅力跟我完全不一样。那不可能行得通。

lines.en: : Besides, wouldn’t that be like, objectifying me or whatever? Aren’t you against that?
lines.zh: : 而且，那不就等于……物化我之类的吗？你不是反对那种事吗？

lines.en: : {i}Not as against it as you might think, slut.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}没你想的那么反对，骚货。{/i}

lines.en: scene chikascarves38
: The fuck did you just-
lines.zh: : 你他妈刚才-

lines.en: : Ignore Io! She wasn’t being serious! And...I think you’d be great, Chika! You don’t need the same appeal as me and Ami! Gyaru maids are like, totally a thing!
lines.zh: : 别理 Io！她不是认真的！而且……我觉得你会很棒的，Chika！你不需要跟我和 Ami 有一样的魅力！辣妹女仆可是完全存在的一个类别！

lines.en: : We don’t have anybody like you! And I’m sure you could make more than whatever you’re making here!
lines.zh: : 我们这儿没有你这种类型的人！而且我敢肯定，你能挣到比在这儿多得多！

lines.en: scene chikascarves39
: Well, how much are you making exactly?
lines.zh: : 那么，你具体挣多少？

lines.en: : I’m going to ignore all of the nights where Sensei shows up as they greatly skew the average, but...on a good night, I can walk out of there with around...20,000 yen?
lines.zh: : 我会把 Sensei 出现的那些晚上全部忽略，因为它们严重拉高了平均值，不过……生意好的晚上，我大概能带着……20000 日元离开？

lines.en: scene chikascarves40
: Maybe...closer to 25,000? We get a percentage of every table and it gets kinda crazy some nights.
lines.zh: : 也许……接近 25000？我们每桌都有提成，有些晚上会疯得不行。

lines.en: : Plus you get to keep the dress. Which isn’t to say that {i}I{/i} would benefit from that in any way. It just seems like a thing you’d want to own since you like clothes.
lines.zh: : 而且你还能留下那条裙子。我不是说{i}我{/i}能从中得到什么好处。只是你喜欢衣服，这看起来像是你会想要拥有的东西。

lines.en: scene chikascarves41
: Do you think I should do it? That’s, like...{i}way{/i} more than I make here.
lines.zh: : 你觉得我该去吗？那可是……比我在这儿挣的多{i}太多{/i}了。

lines.en: : Yes. Adding the maid outfit and shrine maiden dresses to everyone’s wardrobe is my unspoken mission on this planet and I will not rest until it is complete.
lines.zh: : 去。把女仆装和巫女服塞进每个人的衣柜，是我在这个星球上未宣之于口的使命，在完成之前我绝不会休息。

lines.en: : And it won’t be weird for you? Knowing that people would-
lines.zh: : 而且你不会觉得别扭吗？知道那些人会-

lines.en: : Chika.
lines.zh: : Chika。

lines.en: scene chikascarves42
: Oh, yeah! I mean...because you’re my teacher. And a high school girl working somewhere like that might...cause problems!
lines.zh: : 哦，对！我是说……因为你是我的老师。一个高中女生在那种地方工作，可能会……惹麻烦！

lines.en: : But I guess if you’re okay with Uta and Ami doing it, there’s...nothing to worry about at all!
lines.zh: : 不过我想，既然你对 Uta 和 Ami 做这行没意见，那就……完全没什么好担心的了！

lines.en: : Come by when you’re free and I can show you around. I normally work nights. But since I’m {i}basically{/i} the head maid, I can pretty much do whatever I want.
lines.zh: : 你有空的时候过来，我可以带你转转。我一般上晚班。不过既然我{i}基本{/i}算是首席女仆，我基本上想干什么都行。

lines.en: scene chikascarves43
: Uta, you are like, seriously saving my life right now. If there’s ever anything I can do to make it up to you-
lines.zh: : Uta，你真是救了我的命。要是有什么我能报答你的-

lines.en: : You can scratch under my chin and call me a good girl again.
lines.zh: : 你可以挠我的下巴，再叫我一次乖女孩。

lines.en: : Are you sure that’s-
lines.zh: : 你确定那-

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 确定。

lines.en: : I will also volunteer to-
lines.zh: : 我也志愿要-

lines.en: : Please.
lines.zh: : 拜托。

lines.en: : Anyone.
lines.zh: : 谁来都行。

lines.en: : I need this.
lines.zh: : 我需要这个。

lines.en: scene black
Io walks away as Chika and I take turns scratching Uta’s chin.
lines.zh: Io 走开了，Chika 和我轮流挠着 Uta 的下巴。

lines.en: That wasn’t the point of all of this, though — just a nice bonus.
lines.zh: 不过这不是这一切的重点-只是个不错的额外收获。

lines.en: The point is that Chika’s life may soon be changing as well.
lines.zh: 重点是，Chika 的人生可能很快也会改变。

lines.en: And, if I’m remembering correctly, Ami’s eventual appearance at the maid cafe was the first major divergence in the world according to Maya.
lines.zh: 而且，如果我没记错的话，Ami 最终出现在女仆咖啡厅，是 Maya 所说的世界第一个重大分歧点。

lines.en: I doubt Chika, if she decided to follow up on this, will make that same sort of impact.
lines.zh: 我怀疑 Chika 就算决定跟进这件事，也不会造成同样的影响。

lines.en: But it is nice realizing that soon, things might get a little easier for her.
lines.zh: 但意识到她的日子很快会好过一点，还是很不错的。

lines.en: And a lot hornier for both of us.
lines.zh: 而且对我们俩来说，会色情得多。

$ chika_love += 1
{i}Chika’s affection has increased to [chika_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Chika 的好感度提升到了 [chika_love]!{/i}
